name: Helsinki-Vantaa Airport

runway.v: three runways: 04R/22L 3,500 m, 04L/22R 3,060 m and 15/33 2,901 m, all 60 m wide

slots.v: coordinated airport: a slot is needed for every arrival and departure (state, emergency and humanitarian flights exempt); other flights request it at least 3 hours ahead
slots.quote: Helsinki-Vantaa airport is a coordinated airport.

ppr.v: PPR for all aircraft not based at Helsinki-Vantaa, requested through a handling agent (not ATC); not needed when used as alternate or diversion
ppr.quote: The aerodrome is PPR (Prior Permission Required) for aircraft which are not based at Helsinki-Vantaa.

handling.v: ground handling must be appointed in advance for all visiting business and general aviation aircraft
handling.quote: Ground handling must be pre-appointed for all visiting business and general aviation aircraft.

noise.v: noise abatement rules apply (night approach limits; idle reverse thrust only recommended)
noise.quote: Pilots are recommended to avoid reverse thrust except idle thrust after landing.

notes: Read: Finnish eAIP AD 2 EFHK, AIRAC AMDT 006-2025 (27 Nov 2025), the latest edition that search returned; 2026 amendments exist (AMDT 001-2026 of 22 Jan 2026 seen) but the EFHK page in them was not found, so check for changes. The aerodrome operator row reads 'HO'; the tower is H24. Only the first 100,000 characters of the page were read; no general night ban seen, so curfew left missing. Noise times are in UTC (Finland is UTC+2/+3).
